suitabilityFlags.CABRÓN: Source has ordinary male-goat noun and several Mexican colloquial senses; also a strong Mexican profanity/insult. Flag for product suitability, not automatic exclusion of the independent goat sense.
suitabilityFlags.CAGADO: Literal source adjective contains excrement and figurative senses explicitly vulgar; ordinary Mexican register is coarse. Suitability flag distinct from suffix/participle filtering.
suitabilityFlags.IDIOTA: Modern ordinary senses are personal insults/clinical idiocy; several are explicitly derogatory. The untagged clinical sense should not be treated as a neutral learner-register escape.

suitabilityFlags.PINCHE: Kitchen assistant sense is independent; source also explicitly gives Mexican derogatory/vulgar insult/expletive senses. Flag register, do not infer all senses are grammatical forms.

suitabilityFlags.PONERLA: Only independent lexical source sense is penetrar sexualmente. Review sexual slang suitability and attached-clitic base-word policy; do not call it a finite conjugation.
